en: Dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, there arises a mental state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive,
by way of root condition. Dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, there arises a mental state that is not non-demonstrable and with-reactive,
by way of root condition … [and so on] … dependent on a mental state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible-non-reactive and non-conscious, there arise states that are both non-visible-and-reactive and non-conscious by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under object condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible-non-reactive and non-conscious, there arises a state that is non-visible-and-reactive and non-conscious by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are three.
